pages.heading: Warped Toad
pages.body: Warped Forests. Tame and breed with Crimson Mosquito Larva, made from a maggot and mosquito proboscis. Heal with maggots. It can follow, stay or wander and

pages.heading: Warped Toad (cont.)
pages.body: fights insects for its owner. Comfortable in water and lava, but its tolerance does not transfer to you.
